revision_history.note: Rows and values re-read from the workbook with the same SHA-256; the four 2026-10-18 factors are unchanged.

source.method_locator: Introduction!A9: IPCC 2021 GWP 100a; Idemat2026!G2:G3: carbon, kgCO2e

permitted_project_use.paid_software: separate SSIM commercial licensing review and agreement required

factors.product_form: cotton fibre trade mix, without global sea transport
factors.geography: source trade mix China, India and USA; not a Korean production average
assumptions: Use the source trade-mix fibre proxy when origin is unknown.

factors.product_form: virgin PET untextured filament / POY production proxy (80-500 dtex)
assumptions: The extrusion process is an incremental process, not a second PET material inventory.
Use a 1:1 pellet-to-output mass proxy; no unreported yield-loss correction is invented.
For labels with unknown production form, explicitly display the virgin untextured-filament assumption.
This is not a measured or global-average factor for all polyester.
excluded: additional drawing not documented in the source process
factors.display_note_ko: 폴리에스터는 버진 비텍스처 필라멘트 공정의 대체값으로, 재생·단섬유 제품을 대표하지 않습니다.

assumptions: Use the source acrylic-fibre proxy; do not add the PET extrusion process to an existing fibre inventory.

factors.product_form: European scutched flax fibres for spinning linen, source metadata states 12% moisture
assumptions: Use the European flax-fibre proxy for linen; do not map ramie or hemp to linen.

factors.product_form: virgin nylon (50% PA6, 50% PA66 pellets) + untextured filament / POY extrusion proxy (80-500 dtex)
assumptions: Source metadata for the nylon pellet row: copy of Idemat 50% Nylon 6 and 50% Nylon 66.
Apply the same pellet + filament-extrusion method as polyester; the extrusion process is the PET-referenced generic polymer filament process.
Use a 1:1 pellet-to-output mass proxy; no unreported yield-loss correction is invented.
Not a measured or global-average factor for all nylon.
factors.display_note_ko: 나일론은 나일론6·66 수지에 폴리에스터와 같은 필라멘트 압출 공정을 더한 대체값입니다.

factors.product_form: elastane (polyurethane) pellet proxy + generic polymer filament extrusion proxy (80-500 dtex)
assumptions: Source metadata for the elastane pellet row: copy of PUR flex. moulded TDI; it is a polyurethane proxy, not a measured elastane polymer inventory.
Real elastane is mostly dry-spun; the melt-extrusion process is a substitute for fibre formation.
Use a 1:1 pellet-to-output mass proxy; no unreported yield-loss correction is invented.
factors.display_note_ko: 스판덱스·폴리우레탄은 폴리우레탄 수지 대체값에 필라멘트 압출을 더한 값으로, 실제 건식 방사 공정과 다릅니다.

factors.product_form: polyurethane fibre on a garment label treated as elastane; same proxy as spandex
assumptions: Korean garment labels commonly list elastane as polyurethane (폴리우레탄); use the spandex proxy.
Source metadata for the elastane pellet row: copy of PUR flex. moulded TDI; it is a polyurethane proxy, not a measured elastane polymer inventory.
Real elastane is mostly dry-spun; the melt-extrusion process is a substitute for fibre formation.
factors.display_note_ko: 스판덱스·폴리우레탄은 폴리우레탄 수지 대체값에 필라멘트 압출을 더한 값으로, 실제 건식 방사 공정과 다릅니다.

factors.product_form: viscose fibre production; source metadata cites Shen & Patel (2010), fibre type Lenzing Modal
assumptions: The source row is a single Lenzing Modal case used as a substitute for generic rayon, viscose and modal.
The source row is already a fibre inventory (reference flow 1 ton of fibre); do not add the separate viscose spinning process (A.140.03.117).
factors.display_note_ko: 레이온·비스코스·모달은 특정 모달 섬유 사례(Lenzing Modal)를 대신 쓴 값입니다.

factors.product_form: viscose fibre production; source metadata cites Shen & Patel (2010), fibre type Lenzing Modal
assumptions: The source row is a single Lenzing Modal case used as a substitute for generic rayon, viscose and modal.
The source row is already a fibre inventory (reference flow 1 ton of fibre); do not add the separate viscose spinning process (A.140.03.117).
factors.display_note_ko: 레이온·비스코스·모달은 특정 모달 섬유 사례(Lenzing Modal)를 대신 쓴 값입니다.

factors.product_form: viscose fibre production; source metadata cites Shen & Patel (2010), fibre type Lenzing Modal
assumptions: The source row is a single Lenzing Modal case; it is not a modal industry average.
The source row is already a fibre inventory (reference flow 1 ton of fibre); do not add the separate viscose spinning process (A.140.03.117).
factors.display_note_ko: 레이온·비스코스·모달은 특정 모달 섬유 사례(Lenzing Modal)를 대신 쓴 값입니다.

factors.product_form: clean (scoured) merino wool from Australia, transported to Rotterdam
factors.geography: single Australian merino case; not a Korean or global wool average
assumptions: Source metadata: Wiedemann et al. (2015) case 4, merino high-quality wool, 50% yield from greasy wool, economic allocation of 51.8% to wool versus meat.
Transport from Australia to Rotterdam is included in the source value.
Not applied to cashmere, mohair, yak or other animal hair.
factors.display_note_ko: 울은 호주산 메리노 양모(세척 뒤, 유럽까지 운송 포함) 한 사례의 값입니다.

factors.product_form: chrome-tanned leather, hides from Argentina; per kg of leather, not a fibre
factors.geography: single source case; not a Korean or global leather average
assumptions: Source metadata: hides are treated as a by-product of milk and meat production without significant value, so livestock burden is not allocated to the hide.
Chrome tanning is assumed when the tanning method is unknown; vegetable tanning (G7) is not selected.
The garment-mass formula treats leather as the material mass; the fiber scope label does not literally apply.
factors.display_note_ko: 가죽은 크롬 무두질 공정 값이며, 원피를 만드는 축산 단계 배출은 넣지 않았습니다.

factors.product_form: duck down fill from China (Liaoning), transported to Rotterdam
factors.geography: single Chinese duck-down case; the Polish case (G1166, 0.3094105266666667) is not selected
assumptions: Use the higher of the two source down rows (China 0.429 vs Poland 0.309) when origin is unknown; the difference is mainly sea transport.
Source metadata: down is a co-product of meat with economic allocation of about 10%.
Duck down is used for goose down as well.
factors.display_note_ko: 다운·깃털은 중국산 오리털(유럽까지 운송 포함) 한 사례의 값입니다.

factors.product_form: feather fill treated as the duck down fill row from China
assumptions: The source has no separate feather row; the down rows list 'Feather Fill - A mix of larger duck or goose feathers - and Eiderdown' as alternative names.
Use the same China down row as down so that typical down/feather fill labels are not rejected.
factors.display_note_ko: 다운·깃털은 중국산 오리털(유럽까지 운송 포함) 한 사례의 값입니다.

unsupported_material_policy: Reject the whole estimate if any positive-ratio material has no selected compatible factor. Never drop it or substitute a V1/TE value.
cross_version_policy: Keep the original result and source version. Do not present differences between V1, TE research and IDEMAT as emission reductions.
